titolo: What the Palermo Digital Twin is
parole: digital twin, what is it, what is it for, Open Data Sicilia, interactive map, PalermoHub, free.
domande: What is this site?
What is it for?
Who made it?
How much does it cost?
testo:
The Palermo Digital Twin is an interactive map made by Open Data Sicilia. It puts the city's data at everyone's disposal: cadastre, zoning plan, population, buildings, monuments, public transport, road safety, municipal offices and much more. It is meant for reading a place from several points of view: someone looking for a cadastral parcel, someone who wants to understand how a neighbourhood is made, someone studying mobility or services. Every piece of information stays linked to the source it comes from.

With a single click on the map all the layers are queried together and the "place profile" opens. The site is free and works in the browser, on a smartphone too. The code has the EUPL-1.2 licence; the data produced by the project have the CC BY 4.0 licence (attribution: «Digital Twin Palermo, PalermoHub»); third-party data keep the licence of their source (see `07-fonti-avvertenze-glossario.md`). The app is designed and developed by @gbvitrano in collaboration with Claude AI (Anthropic).

titolo: How the screen is laid out
parole: interface, menu, bar, tabs, panels, where to find, layout, toolbar.
domande: Where are the controls?
What is in the menu at the top?
What are the side bars?
testo:
- **At the top**, next to the logo, the menu with the information pages (see `51-pagine-privacy-lingua-e-offline.md`) and the IT/EN language button.
- **In the centre** the map. The **search** field and the «Reset» button (see `44-ricerca-e-filtri.md`).
- **On the left** the layers bar with five tabs: «Basemap», «Layers», «RNDT», «My layers», «Filters» (see `45-barra-strati-legende-e-ordine.md`).
- **On the right** the panels bar: «Profile» (it opens with a click on the map), «RNDT», «Geoimage», «Theme».
- **At the top right** the toolbar: initial view, data table, 3D view, layers in 3D, RNDT catalogue, full screen, print, share, Street View, light/dark theme.
- **At the bottom** the legends of the layers that are switched on and the footer with the notice about legal value; on the map there is also the zoom slider.
- **On a smartphone** a bar of four tabs at the bottom (Map, Layers, Add, Menu).

parole: guided paths, path, theme, ready-made themes, home page, home, «Open the map», layers already on, shortcut.
domande: What are the guided paths?
How do I open the map with the right layers already switched on?
Which paths are there?
Where do I find the guided paths?
testo:
The guided paths are on the home page of the site, in the «What you can switch on» section, under the title «Guided paths». A path can also be activated from Talia: below the answer there are the buttons of the paths, and one click switches on the layers of the path (a second click switches them off). Each path is a card with a title, a sentence saying what it is about, the list of the layers it includes and the «Open the map» button. The button opens the map with those layers already switched on, with the legends already active on the map and, for the «Urban planning» path, already centred on the area indicated by the path (zoom 16). The other paths leave the map in the starting view. Once the map is open, the layers can be switched off, switched on and changed as usual (see `45-barra-strati-legende-e-ordine.md`).

There are ten paths:

- **Risks and climate**: Geomorphological hazard, Hydraulic hazard, Coastal erosion hazard, Fires, Heat islands
- **Schools and neighbourhoods**: Municipal schools and nurseries, Polling sections (sites), Neighbourhoods, Population by section
- **Mobility**: Metro line, Bus lines, Stops, Charging points, Fuel stations
- **A city in transformation**: NRRP projects, Public works, Population trend 2011-2023
- **Heritage and greenery**: Monuments, Monumental trees, Public drinking fountains, Former Noviziato dei Crociferi in 3D
- **Urban planning**: Zoning plan 2004: zoning and PPE, Zoning plan 2004: constraints, Cadastre: parcels, OMI zones 2025, House numbers
- **Road safety**: Accident hotspots, The 20 most dangerous streets, Accidents per km on roads, Accidents
- **Who commutes**: Commuting to and from Palermo 2021, Population by section, Metro line, Stops
- **An accessible city**: Architectural barriers, Municipal offices (sites), Stops, Municipal schools and nurseries
- **Public property**: Properties declared to the MEF, Municipal properties, Municipal offices (sites), Cadastre: parcels

The text of the path is available in Italian and in English, according to the language chosen.

The paths are for those who do not know where to start. Those who want to choose the layers one by one use the «Layer catalogue» instead, further down the same page: there each layer has the «Add to the map» button and the bar of the chosen layers opens the map with the selected ones.

titolo: Clicking on the map: the place profile
parole: click, profile, place, tap, profile tabs, Place, Planning tools, Market, Population, Terrain, Roadside services, NRRP, Works, Other data.
domande: How do I see the data of a point?
Which sections does the profile have?
Where do I see the parcel or the constraints?
testo:
To get to know a place it is enough to click on the map, or tap it on a smartphone: on opening, an invitation reminds you (see `51-pagine-privacy-lingua-e-offline.md`). The point is highlighted (see `46-selezione-in-mappa-raggio-e-fumetti.md`) and the profile opens. A single click queries all the layers together: cadastre, zoning plan constraints, road safety, cultural heritage, public transport and the others that are switched on.

The profile is divided into tabs, which appear only if they have content: **Place**, **Planning tools**, **Market**, **Population**, **Terrain**, **Roadside services**, **NRRP**, **Works**, **Other data (RNDT)**. In particular:
- **Place**: address, building, nearby stops and fuel stations, monuments, schools, offices and more, with district, neighbourhood and UPL in the heading.
- **Planning tools**: building, cadastral parcel with the link to SISTER, zoning and constraints of the zoning plan, PAI constraints and fires.
- **Market**: OMI quotations. **Population**: census section, demographic trend, commuting.
- **Terrain**: the terrain (DTM 5 m) and the heat island. **Roadside services**: charging points and drinking fountains.
- **NRRP** and **Works**: projects and public works. **Other data (RNDT)**: the layers added from the catalogue and from «My layers».

Every section indicates its source. At the bottom of every profile there is the notice that the data are informational and have no legal value (see `07-fonti-avvertenze-glossario.md`). The details of each profile section are in the files `08`–`33`, the dynamic parts in `34`–`36`.

titolo: Shapes and icons of the point layers
parole: icon, shape, symbol, circle, legend, colour blindness, black and white.
domande: What do the icons mean?
Why are some points circles?
testo:
On the point layers colour is not the only sign: each layer has its own shape or icon, the same on the map, in the legend and in the box that appears when the mouse passes over it. This way the themes can be told apart even when printing in black and white or when having difficulty seeing colours.
- The MEF properties have the euro icon.
- The architectural barriers (PEBA) have an icon for each group (historic route, city street, square, green area, museum…).
- Schools: mortarboard. Polling sites: ballot in the box. Fuel stations: pump. Charging points: plug. Drinking fountains: drop. Monumental trees: tree.
- The municipal offices have the icon of the building at the centre of the ring: the bigger it is, the more offices it hosts.
- The monuments have an icon for each category (church, colonnade, theatre, house, palace, palette, book, tree, market, ruins, shield, pin).
- Accidents, stops and commuting remain circles.

parole: cadastre, parcel, sheet, number, land registry search, cadastral extract, SITR, Agenzia delle Entrate, property boundary.
domande: How do I find a parcel?
What does the cadastre layer show?
Can I get the cadastral extract?
testo:
The «Cadastre: parcels» layer (Territory group, visible from zoom 12) shows the cadastral parcels of Palermo: about 243,700, from the SITR of the Sicilian Region and the Agenzia delle Entrate (September 2026). The labels «F. [foglio] - P. [particella]» appear from zoom 15 (16 on a smartphone), with the «Sheet and parcel» switch in the legend.

A click opens the profile: in the «Planning tools» section the parcel appears with sheet and number and the link to the cadastral extract. To search for one directly, use the «Filters» tab (sheet and number) or the search field.

The cadastral data are informational only: they do not replace official extracts or certificates.

parole: PRG, zoning plan, zoning, ZTO, zone A B C D E F, PPE, historic centre, historic core, land-use designation.
domande: What planning zone is this point in?
What is the PPE?
Is the zoning plan up to date?
testo:
The «Zoning plan 2004: zoning and PPE» layer shows the 2004 General Variant to the zoning plan: the homogeneous territorial zones (ZTO) and the Executive Detailed Plan (PPE) of the historic centre. For the historic centre the profile indicates the area (historic centre, historic core) and the instrument (PPE).

The legend of the PRG and of the PPE is in the panel. Data from the Municipality of Palermo, reworked by OpenDataSicilia (CC BY 4.0).

Warning: this is the 2004 general variant. Later variants may not be included. For legal uses the certificate of urban planning designation is needed.

parole: constraints, area constraints, linear constraints, protection, buffer zones.
domande: Are there constraints on this area?
Where do I see the constraints?
testo: The «Zoning plan 2004: constraints» layer shows the area and linear constraints of the zoning plan. A click on a point lists the overlapping constraints in the «Planning tools» section of the profile, next to the zoning. They are informational data, with no legal value.

parole: OMI, quotations, house prices, rent, sale, €/m², Agenzia delle Entrate, property market, band.
domande: How much does a house cost in this area?
What is an OMI zone?
testo: The «OMI zones 2025» layer (second half of 2025) shows the zones of the Osservatorio del Mercato Immobiliare of the Agenzia delle Entrate. The profile, in the «Market» section, gives zone, band with description, micro-zone and the quotation ranges: sale in €/m² and rent in €/m² per month, by type. They are indicative quotations, not transaction prices or valuations.

parole: house numbers, street number, address, ANNCSU.
domande: How do I find a house number?
From which zoom level are they visible?
testo: The «House numbers» layer (visible from zoom 14) shows the house numbers of the Municipality of Palermo (updated February 2026). The house numbers also feed the address search.

parole: municipal properties, municipal assets, municipal buildings, automatic georeferencing.
domande: Which properties does the Municipality own?
Are the positions exact?
testo: The «Municipal properties» section of the Territory group shows the properties of the Municipality of Palermo (2024 data). The positions are the result of automatic georeferencing and are purely indicative. For the public assets declared to the Ministry of Economy and Finance see also the «Properties declared to the MEF» layer.

parole: PAI, landslide, flood, hazard, hydraulic risk, geomorphological, instabilities, coastal erosion, attention sites, River Basin Authority.
domande: Is this area at risk of landslide or flood?
What is the PAI?
testo:
The «PAI plan» group presents the Hydrogeological Assessment Plan of the Sicilian Region for the Municipality of Palermo: the 12 themes of the plan: hydraulic hazard and risk, hydraulic attention sites, floods (discharge manoeuvre and collapse), geomorphological hazard and risk, geomorphological attention sites, P3 and P4 buffer zone, instabilities (by activity and by type), coastal erosion hazard and risk, with the official symbology of the server.

A click on an area opens the profile: in the «Planning tools» section the «PAI constraints» box appears with the most severe class among those overlapping. They are informational data: for legal uses the official cartography of the River Basin Authority applies.

parole: fires, burnt areas, fire, Bellolampo, Fire Census, wooded area.
domande: Where have there been fires?
How many hectares have burnt?
testo: The «Fires» layer (Territory group, from zoom 12) shows the areas swept by fire in the Municipality of Palermo since 2007, year by year, from the Fire Census of the Sicilian Region. The colour indicates the year. The profile of a fire gives date, locality, total and wooded area and, when available, the crews that intervened. If several fires overlap, the profile lists them all. In the search you can filter by year (for example «incendi 2023»).

parole: heat islands, temperature, heat, Landsat, LST, summer, surface, census sections.
domande: Where is it hottest in the city?
Is the temperature the air temperature?
testo:
The «Heat islands» layer (Territory group, from zoom 10) shows the summer surface temperature obtained from the Landsat 8 and 9 satellites (USGS) for the 3,600 census sections of 2021; the map shows the year 2025. **It is the temperature of the surface, not of the air.**

The legend lets you choose the classification method (Jenks, quantiles, equal intervals) and from 3 to 9 classes, and shows the chart of the municipal trend from 2019 to 2025. The profile has the «Heat island» entry: summer temperature, difference from the municipal average and change since 2019. The link leads to the full PalermoHub study. Data: Landsat (public domain) processed by ISTAT section; OpenDataSicilia / PalermoHub study (CC BY 4.0).

parole: relief, DTM, altitude, elevation, hillshade, slope, terrain.
domande: How do I see the relief?
What elevation does this point have?
What is the DTM?
testo: The «Terrain» group has two layers: «3D terrain with hillshade» and «Elevation (coloured raster)». They are based on the 5-metre digital terrain model (HR-DTM-5m, IRPI-CNR, Panza et al. 2026, PalermoHub processing). The place profile includes a «Terrain (DTM 5 m)» entry with elevation, slope and morphometric indices.

parole: boundaries, districts, neighbourhoods, UPL, first-level units, census sections, AMAP, water districts.
domande: Which district am I in?
What is a UPL?
How many census sections are there?
testo: The «Boundaries» group has five layers: Districts (8, switched on at start-up), Neighbourhoods (25), UPL (55), AMAP water districts and Census sections (from zoom 13, the 2021 ISTAT ones). The UPL (first-level unit) is a subdivision of the Municipality finer than the neighbourhood. Data ISTAT / Municipality of Palermo (2021).

parole: buildings, built-up area, footprints, 3D, height, building use, population per building.
domande: How do I see the buildings?
Can I see them in 3D?
How many inhabitants does a building have?
testo: The «Buildings» group has the «Built-up area» layer (from zoom 12), with the footprints of about 111,800 buildings (volumetric units of the Municipal Technical Map), and «3D buildings», which extrudes them. The place profile shows the building with its use. The population per building is an **estimate**. In 3D view the buildings of the point layers (monuments, schools, polling sites, municipal offices, municipal properties, MEF, PEBA) are coloured.

parole: population, inhabitants, residents, census section, ISTAT, permanent census, density, indicators.
domande: How many inhabitants does my neighbourhood have?
Where do the data come from?
testo: The «Population by section» layer (Population group) shows the residents by census section from the ISTAT permanent census (2021 and 2023). The values by section are **sample estimates**, not exact counts. In 2023 the sections are 3,090 against the 3,600 of 2021. In the «Population» tab the «Census section» card gives the ISTAT code of the section and the indicators calculated for the selected year, a ranking with district, neighbourhood and UPL, and the links to «Demographic exploration», ANNCUS and the PalermoHub bivariate maps (density × public transport supply, house number density × population, population exposed to hydrogeological risk).

parole: trend, population trend, decline, growth, 2011, 2021, 2023, projection, 2030, 2035, depopulation.
domande: Is Palermo's population shrinking?
Which neighbourhood is growing?
What will happen by 2035?
testo:
The «Population trend 2011-2023» layer (Population group) shows how the population of UPL, neighbourhoods and districts changes between the 2011, 2021 and 2023 censuses (ISTAT). The colour is the percentage change (purple decline, green growth). The level (UPL, Neighbourhood, District) and the symbol (pill with the percentage or line chart) are chosen from the legend.

ISTAT totals: 2011 about 657,600 inhabitants, 2021 about 635,400, 2023 about 630,400. The chart includes a **trend scenario** to 2030 and 2035: it is a simple projection, with an uncertainty band, not a cohort demographic model. For the Municipality the central projection to 2035 is about 606,000 inhabitants (range 593,700-614,400).

Cautions: the traditional 2011 census and the permanent 2021/2023 census are not fully comparable; a decline over two years is not a trend. Strong increases in the historic centre (the UPL «Tribunali o Kalsa» is at +27.3 % between 2011 and 2021, the I district at +14.8 %) are to be read as repopulation, with caution because of the change of method. The place profile, in the «Population» tab, shows the charts of the three levels for the point.

parole: commuting, home-work trips, commuters, ISTAT 2021, inbound, outbound, balance, connected municipalities.
domande: How many people come to work in Palermo?
Where do the people of Palermo go to work?
testo: The «Commuting to and from Palermo 2021» layer (Population group) shows the home-work trips between Palermo and the other municipalities (ISTAT, 2021 Census): who goes out, who comes in and how many both live and work in the city, with the rankings of the connected municipalities. For the municipality clicked, the profile gives: Inbound (work in Palermo), Outbound (Palermo residents) and Balance (inbound minus outbound). PalermoHub processing (CC BY 4.0).

titolo: Public transport: bus, tram, metro and railway
parole: bus, tram, metro, railway, AMAT, RFI, Trenitalia, stops, lines, GTFS, railway link, railway ring.
domande: Which lines pass here?
Where are the stops?
Which layers are there for transport?
testo:
The «Transport» group has five layers: **Bus lines**, **Tram lines** and **Stops** (AMAT section) and **Metro line** and **Metro stations** (RFI section). The data are the GTFS feeds of AMAT (about 71 lines: 67 bus and 4 tram; over 1,600 stops) and of Trenitalia for the urban railway (Passante ferroviario, Anello ferroviario and other services). Two stations (Politeama and Porto) are marked «opening soon».

To open a line, switch on the layers and click on the route or on a stop. In the «Lines» box you choose the line and, in its block, you open «Stops»: they appear in sequence like a strip diagram, with the line in its colour, a dot for each stop and the terminals larger. The coloured boxes next to each stop are the other lines that pass there (interchanges). A click on the box takes the map to the stop and shows the route of that line; a click on the name opens the stop profile with the next departures. An arrival-only terminal says so: no services depart from there and the timetables are at the departure stop.

When you click on the map the profile also shows the nearby stops, within the radius that can be adjusted from the «Selection on the map» legend.

parole: timetables, next departures, expired feed, update, validity, GTFS.
domande: Are the timetables up to date?
Why does the map say the feed has expired?
testo: The timetables update by themselves. Every day the site checks the Municipality's open data portal and, when AMAT publishes a new feed, stops, lines and timetables are replaced. The same goes for the urban railway with the Trenitalia GTFS feed (converted from NeTEx by Clément Desouche, CC BY 4.0). If the feed in use has expired, the map says so. The timetables are those of the GTFS feeds. At the time of writing (October 2026) the AMAT feed is valid from 25/08/2026 to 31/10/2026 and the urban railway one from 26/09/2026 to 12/12/2026; the dates change at every update.

parole: accidents, road safety, dangerous roads, hotspot, crashes, fatal, Municipal Police, accidents per km.
domande: Which are the most dangerous roads?
Where do most accidents happen?
How do I filter by year?
testo:
The «Road safety» group has four layers:
- **Accidents per km on roads**: accident rate by road section.
- **The 20 most dangerous streets**: the streets with the most weighted severity per km (streets of at least 3 km and 30 accidents).
- **Accident hotspots**: 250 m cells with statistically significant concentration (Getis-Ord Gi*).
- **Accidents** (from zoom 14): the single events, about 23,500, from 2015 to 2023 (2019 is not in the dataset). The filter by year and severity is in the «Filters» tab.

The place profile gives the accident risk of the point («Safety»), the zone of concentrated accidents and, for the most dangerous streets, rank, severity, fatalities and kilometres. Source of the accidents: Municipality of Palermo (Municipal Police); PalermoHub / OpenDataSicilia processing. The data are a statistical analysis, not a technical assessment of how dangerous a road is.

parole: monuments, churches, palaces, theatres, museums, Teatro Massimo, Tourism Portal, places of interest, categories.
domande: Where are the historic churches?
How do I see the profile of a monument?
Which categories are there?
testo:
The «Monuments (Tourism Portal)» layer (Monuments group) shows about 4,000 places of historical and cultural interest. There are two sources: the Tourism Portal of the Municipality of Palermo («Cosa Vedere») and the «Monumental map of Palermo and the Palermo countryside» by Marcello Petrucci, merged without duplicates. Where it was possible to match them, the building is also coloured on the map.

Categories (which can be filtered in the legend): Churches and Oratories, Monuments, Theatres, Historic residences and villas, Palaces, Art galleries and museums, Libraries, Gardens and green spaces, Historic markets, Archaeological areas, Shelters and war memorials, Other places. Each category has its own icon.

A click opens the profile with photo, description, category and the link to the Tourism Portal, from which the texts come. Some monuments no longer exist: they are flagged in the profile («no longer existing»). Texts and photos belong to the Municipality of Palermo and to the author of the map.

parole: trees, monumental trees, MASAF, species, circumference, height, ficus.
domande: Where are the monumental trees?
How many are there?
testo: The «Monumental trees (MASAF)» layer (Monuments group) shows about 46 monumental trees of Palermo from the list of the Ministry of Agriculture (MASAF). The profile gives species, locality, altitude, circumference, height, the monumentality criteria and the proposal for a declaration of notable public interest. Details in `14-scheda-alberi-monumentali.md`.

parole: drinking fountains, water, drink, fountain, drinking water.
domande: Where do I find a drinking fountain?
How many are there?
testo: The «Public drinking fountains» layer (Monuments group) shows about 150 public drinking fountains with type of location, name, address, UPL, neighbourhood and district, and the link to the in-depth pages on PalermoHub. In the legend they are shown with the drop icon.

parole: schools, nurseries, school buildings, institutes, school, children.
domande: Where are the schools?
How many municipal nurseries are there?
testo: In the «Roadside services» group, the «Schools and polling sections» section has the «Municipal schools and nurseries» layer: about 271 points among nurseries, school buildings and institute offices, with the mortarboard icon. Open data of the Municipality of Palermo (2017): for this reason some sites may have changed. Each point is matched, where possible, to the building.

parole: polling sections, polling stations, vote, elections, where do I vote, polling station.
domande: Where is my polling station?
How many sections are there in one site?
testo: The «Polling sections (sites)» layer (same section as the schools) shows the voting sites (132 in the data: 75 coincide with a school and are merged with the school, 57 are separate) with the list of the sections they host; the icon is the ballot in the box. Open data of the Municipality (2017): for your own polling station the electoral card always applies.

parole: offices, Municipality, areas, sectors, managers, contacts, Palazzo Palagonia, PEC, site.
domande: Where is office X?
Who is in charge?
How do I contact an office?
testo: The «Municipal offices (sites)» layer (Roadside services group) shows the 81 sites of the offices of the Municipality of Palermo. The more offices a site has, the bigger the ring. The profile of a site lists areas, sectors and operational units with managers, phone numbers, emails and PEC, when published, with the link to the office page. You can filter by area from the legend. Data from the Municipality's institutional website (extraction 3 October 2026): for official contacts the Municipality's website prevails.

parole: charging points, charging, electric cars, EV, power, operator, status, direct current, alternating current.
domande: Where do I charge my electric car?
Is the charging point free?
testo: The «Charging points» layer (Roadside services group) shows about 250 charging points with live status, power and operator. The status («Available», «Charging», «Inactive») is read live, with a fallback file updated every hour; «in use» is seen only for the charging points with real-time status; the legend has filters by status and type of current. The information on availability is indicative and depends on the data source.

parole: fuel stations, petrol stations, gas stations, filling stations, petrol, gasoline, unleaded, diesel, LPG, methane, CNG, white pumps, independent stations, prices, brand, fuel, Osservaprezzi, MIMIT.
domande: Where is petrol cheapest?
Which stations sell methane?
testo: The «Fuel stations» layer (Roadside services group) shows about 216 stations in Palermo with brand, address, fuels sold and prices reported by the operators (petrol, diesel, LPG, methane). The icon is the pump, in the colour of the brand. The legend filters by brand and by fuel. The data come from the MIMIT Osservaprezzi carburanti, regenerated every day (IODL 2.0 licence). The prices are those reported by the operators and may not match those at the pump.

parole: NRRP, PNRR, Italia Domani, projects, mission, implementing body, CUP, funding, amounts, progress status.
domande: Which NRRP projects are there in Palermo?
How much money is coming?
Who carries out a project?
testo:
The «NRRP projects» layer (Territory group) shows the projects of the National Recovery and Resilience Plan (PNRR) located in the city of Palermo only, from the Italia Domani open data (extraction of 13 June 2026): about 2,630 projects for about 921 million euro of PNRR funding.

On the map there are only the projects that have a place (about 1,280, grouped in ring markers divided into slices, one per mission, with the number of projects). The others (training, research, doctorates, networks such as tram and bus) have no place: they can be consulted in the profile and in the full list in CSV. The schools are positioned at their site (AgID IPA addresses).

The legend filters by mission, site and implementing body. In the profile, «NRRP» tab: each project with status (In Corso or Concluso), mission (M1…M7), implementing body clickable as a filter, amounts and link to the CUP on OpenCUP; the «NRRP in Palermo» section has totals and charts on all the projects, and a drop-down menu opens the projects of the Municipality and the University. Source: Italia Domani / Sogei (CC BY 4.0).

parole: public works, building sites, BDAP, MOP, State General Accounting Department, owner, sector, work phase, costs.
domande: Which public works are there?
How much does this work cost?
Who is carrying it out?
testo:
The «Public works» layer (Territory group) shows the public works located in the city of Palermo only from the BDAP-MOP open data of the State General Accounting Department (Ragioneria generale dello Stato): about 1,350 works, with a planned cost of works of about 2.1 billion euro. Owners: Municipality, Metropolitan City, ANAS, IACP, health authorities and others.

On the map there are only the works for which an address was found (about 705): the others can be consulted in the profile, «Works» tab. The ANAS works are not on the map (addresses such as «SS 113»). The positions derive from the house numbers (there are no coordinates in the source), so they may be approximate.

The legend filters by 10 sectors, by works with a closed CUP and by owner. The profile gives owner, sector, work phase (derived from the actual dates: the source does not give progress), costs and declared funding. No totals on funding: there are anomalous values in the source. Source: Open BDAP, licence «CC BY – libero riuso citando la fonte». None of the works on the map coincides with a PNRR project (different CUPs).

parole: MEF, public properties, public assets, Treasury Department, property census, assets, cadastre.
domande: Which public properties are there in Palermo?
What does «declared to the MEF» mean?
testo:
The «Properties declared to the MEF» layer (Territory group) shows the real estate assets of the Municipality of Palermo declared in the census of the Ministry of Economy and Finance (Treasury Department, year 2023): about 8,000 assets. They are attached to buildings (about 1,260), to land (about 480 parcels) or to points. The icon is the euro.

The position of each asset is checked against the cadastre (sheet and parcel), then against the layers already mapped (municipal properties, schools, polling sites, offices, monuments), then against the declared position. The «Property declared to the MEF» profile lists the assets of the building. Source: MEF (CC BY 4.0).

parole: PEBA, architectural barriers, accessibility, disability, wheelchair, critical issues, PDF form, routes, UNESCO.
domande: Is a building or a street accessible?
What does the PEBA score mean?
testo:
The «Architectural barriers» layer (Territory group) presents the Plan for the Elimination of Architectural Barriers of the Municipality of Palermo (Giunta Resolution no. 272 of 18/07/2026): 209 survey forms on administrative sites, schools, nurseries, green areas, streets, historic and UNESCO routes, squares and museums.

Each form has accessibility level, inaccessibility score, relevance, priority class, estimated cost, critical issues found, photos of the inspection (with a viewer) and PDF form. Buildings and green areas are polygons, the rest points with an icon for each group. OpenDataSicilia and PalermoHub processing (CC BY 4.0).

Warning: forms, texts and photos were extracted automatically from the original PDFs and the coordinates derive from the geocoding of the addresses: there may be errors or imprecise positioning.

parole: Crociferi, Noviziato, 3D model, floor plans, elevations, DWG, historic centre, rooms.
domande: What is the Crociferi layer?
Can I see the floor plans of the building?
testo: The «Former Noviziato dei Crociferi in 3D» layer (Buildings group, **in development**) raises the floor plans of the building floor by floor: exploded levels, plan view with room numbers and elevations of the façades. The data come from the DWG plans, sections and elevations of the Municipality of Palermo, Historic Centre Department; the 3D model is a processing by the project.

parole: sources, where the data comes from, bodies, datasets, licence, license, open data, attribution, credits.
domande: Where does the data come from?
Where can I find the sources?
Can I reuse the data?
testo:
The map uses data published by public bodies and open data projects:
- Comune di Palermo: schools, offices, polling stations, street numbers, municipal properties, accidents, master plan, technical map, tourism portal.
- Regione Siciliana: cadastre (SITR), PAI, fire census.
- ISTAT: census sections, 2011/2021/2023 indicators, 2021 commuting, boundaries.
- Agenzia delle Entrate: OMI zones and cadastre.
- AMAT (bus and tram) and Trenitalia (urban rail): GTFS feeds.
- Ministries and agencies: MEF (properties), MIMIT (fuel), MASAF (monumental trees), Ragioneria generale dello Stato (BDAP-MOP), Italia Domani (PNRR), AgID (IPA).
- Open data projects: OpenDataSicilia and PalermoHub (PEBA, heat islands, trends, safety, historical atlas), OpenStreetMap.

The full list, with date, link to the original data and link to the licence, is on the «Sources and notes» page of the menu (on a smartphone, in the «Menu» tab).

parole: licence, license, CC BY 4.0, ODbL, IODL, EUPL, reuse, attribution, copyright.
domande: Can I use the data in a publication?
How do I cite the source?
testo:
- The code is under the EUPL-1.2 licence.
- The data produced by the project is CC BY 4.0; attribution required: «Digital Twin Palermo, PalermoHub».
- Third-party data keeps the licence of its source: most of it is CC BY 4.0 (citing the source); MIMIT fuel prices are IODL 2.0; OpenStreetMap is ODbL (attribution and share-alike); for the Crociferi plans and for some of the Comune's data, the conditions of the rights holder given in `NOTICE.md` in the repository apply.
- Before reusing third-party data it is advisable to check the conditions with the rights holder. The same caution applies to the texts and photos of the monuments.
- Export from the data table is available for all the layers listed; each file states the source and licence of the layer (see `40-tabella-dei-dati-ed-esportazione.md`).

parole: disclaimer, legal value, informational, land-use certificate, cadastral extract, errors, reliability, trust.
domande: Can I use this data for a notarial deed?
Is the data official?
Can I trust it?
testo: Cadastre, zoning and restrictions have **informational value only** and do not replace the land-use certificate (certificato di destinazione urbanistica) or the official cadastral extracts. The master plan is the 2004 general variant: later variants may not be included. Census data are sample estimates, so the values per section are not exact counts. The positions of some layers (municipal properties, works, PNRR, PEBA) come from automatic georeferencing and may be inaccurate. For legal uses, always contact the competent offices. At the bottom of every profile there is the notice: informational data, with no legal value.

parole: acronym, abbreviation, meaning, what is, glossary, what does it stand for.
domande: What does UPL mean?
What is the OMI?
What are PAI, PEBA, GTFS?
testo:
- **UPL**: Unità di primo livello (first-level unit), a subdivision of the Comune finer than the neighbourhood.
- **PRG**: Piano regolatore generale (master plan; here the 2004 variant). **ZTO**: the acronym of the zones of the PRG zoning (the «ZTO» field). **PPE**: Piano Particolareggiato Esecutivo (detailed executive plan) of the historic centre.
- **PAI**: Piano di Assetto Idrogeologico (hydrogeological risk plan) of the Regione Siciliana.
- **OMI**: Osservatorio del Mercato Immobiliare (real estate market observatory) of the Agenzia delle Entrate.
- **SITR**: mapping service of the Regione Siciliana (map.sitr.regione.sicilia.it).
- **PEBA**: Piano di Eliminazione delle Barriere Architettoniche (plan for removing architectural barriers).
- **PNRR**: Piano nazionale di ripresa e resilienza (National Recovery and Resilience Plan). **CUP**: the project code shown in the PNRR and public works profiles, with the link to OpenCUP.
- **BDAP / MOP**: Open BDAP of the Ragioneria generale dello Stato, «Monitoraggio Opere Pubbliche (MOP)» (Public Works Monitoring), the source of the public works.
- **MEF**: Ministero dell'economia e delle finanze (Ministry of Economy and Finance). **MIMIT**: Ministero delle Imprese e del Made in Italy (Ministry of Enterprises and Made in Italy). **MASAF**: Ministero dell'agricoltura, della sovranità alimentare e delle foreste (Ministry of Agriculture, Food Sovereignty and Forests).
- **RNDT**: Repertorio Nazionale dei Dati Territoriali (National Register of Spatial Data). **WMS / WMTS / WFS / XYZ**: types of map and geographic data services.
- **GTFS**: the timetable feeds from which the stops, lines and timetables of buses, trams and urban rail come. **AMAT**: the public transport company (bus and tram). **RFI**: this is the name of the «Metro line» and «Metro stations» sections of the Transport group.
- **LST**: land surface temperature (it is not the air temperature). **DTM**: digital terrain model.
- **GCP**: Ground Control Point, a control point for georeferencing. **RMSE**: root mean square error.
- **ISTAT**: Istituto nazionale di statistica (national statistics institute). **ANNCSU**: Archivio nazionale dei numeri civici e delle strade urbane (national archive of street numbers and urban streets). **AMAP**: AMAP S.p.A., the source of the water districts and drinking fountains.
- **IPA**: Indice delle Pubbliche Amministrazioni (Index of Public Administrations, AgID).

titolo: Questions the guide does not answer
parole: off topic, I don't know, does not answer, help, support, report an error, report a problem.
domande: Can I ask for a building permit?
When does the bus arrive in real time?
How do I report an error?

parole: terrain profile, DTM, elevation, metres above sea level, 50 m grid, morphological analysis, slope, morphology.
domande: What is in the Terrain profile?
Where do these values come from?
What elevation is it?
testo:
The «Terrain (DTM 5 m)» profile appears in the place profile when you click on the map. The title has as its badge the elevation in metres above sea level (for example «45 m a.s.l.»). It is a collapsible section, open at the start.

The values are not calculated at the exact point clicked: they are those of the **nearest DTM grid point**, with a 50-metre spacing (note at the bottom of the profile). They derive from the 5-metre digital terrain model (HR-DTM-5m, IRPI-CNR, Panza et al. 2026, processed by PalermoHub). At the bottom there is the «Interactive morphological analysis» link to the dedicated PalermoHub page.

The values are divided into groups: Slope, Morphology, Slope risk, Morphometric indices, Hydrology, Energy and climate, Accessibility and erosion. If a value is missing for the point, the profile shows «—», and the Energy and climate and Accessibility and erosion groups appear only if there is data.

parole: slope, degrees, percentage, aspect, hillside, landform, terrain shape, geomorphology, north south.
domande: How steep is the terrain?
Which way does the slope face?
What shape is the terrain?
testo:
- **Slope**: in degrees (for example 8.5°) and as a percentage (for example 14.9 %).
- **Morphology**: «Aspect» (which direction the slope faces) and «Landform» (morphological class of the point, as text).

titolo: Terrain: slope risk, stability and buildability
parole: stability, buildability, slope risk, classes 1-5, landslide, building suitability, unstable ground.
domande: Is the ground stable?
Can one build here?
What do classes 1 to 5 mean?
testo:
The «Slope risk» group has two rows:
- **Stability**: assessment of the slope (text).
- **Buildability**: assessment of how buildable the terrain is (text).

Each row has a class from 1 (best) to 5 (worst), shown with a colour. If the class is not available it is not coloured. For official restrictions there are the PAI layer and the master plan (see the warnings: the data is informational).

parole: TRI, TPI, SRI, HS, hillshade, ruggedness, topographic position, indices.
domande: What are TRI and TPI?
What does HS mean?
testo:
The «Morphometric indices» group shows four values in a grid:
- **TRI**: terrain ruggedness index (how irregular it is).
- **TPI**: topographic position index (position of the point relative to its surroundings).
- **SRI**: another morphometric index calculated from the terrain model.
- **HS**: the shading value (hillshade).

parole: TWI, SPI, flow accumulation, DTW, water table, moisture, runoff, drainage.
domande: What is the TWI?
Does water tend to collect here?
testo:
The «Hydrology» group reports:
- **TWI, topographic moisture**: moisture index linked to the shape of the terrain.
- **SPI, Stream Power**: erosive capacity of surface runoff.
- **Flow Acc. (log)**: accumulation of runoff upstream of the point (on a logarithmic scale), if available.
- **DTW, water table depth**: in metres, if available.

parole: SVF, sky view, visible sky, photovoltaic, PV potential, summer shade, winter shade, frost, solar radiation.
domande: Is the point suitable for photovoltaics?
How much shade is there in summer and in winter?
testo:
The «Energy and climate» group (if there is data) has:
- **SVF, visible sky**: percentage of sky visible from the point.
- **PV potential**: photovoltaic potential as a percentage.
- **Summer shade** and **Winter shade**: percentage of shade cast by the relief.
- **Frost risk**: numerical index calculated by the model.

parole: Tobler, walking speed, visibility, viewshed, RUSLE, soil erosion, walking.
domande: How fast can one walk here?
Is the point very visible?
Is there a risk of erosion?
testo:
The «Accessibility and erosion» group (if there is data) has:
- **Tobler speed**: estimated walking speed in km/h on the slope of the point (calculated with Tobler's function).
- **Cumulative visibility**: how many of the 6 reference observation points can see the point.
- **RUSLE LS erosion**: topographic factor of the RUSLE soil erosion model.

parole: road segment, arc, accidents per km, rate, slope, accessibility by slope, landslide risk, flood risk, dangerous street.
domande: What does the profile of a street show?
What does «accidents per km» mean?
Why does it say «not significant»?
testo:
When you click on a street with the «Accidents per km on roads» layer (or the 20 most dangerous streets) switched on, the profile has the street name as its title (or «Unnamed street») and the badge «Road segment». Below the title appear the neighbourhood, district and UPL. The groups:

- **One of the most dangerous streets** (only if the street is in the ranking of the 20): position in the ranking (for example «3 of 20»), severity per km of the street, accidents on the street with the kilometres, fatalities on the street.
- **Safety**: «Accidents 2015–2023» (a number, or «No accidents recorded») and «Accidents per km». If the segment is shorter than 20 metres the rate says «not significant (segment < 20 m)», because over a few metres the rate is not reliable.
- **Segment**: length in metres, average slope as a percentage, accessibility by slope.
- **Hydrogeological risk**: landslide risk and landslide priority, flood risk and flood priority, from the PAI. Rows with no risk («no…») are not shown.

At the bottom there is the note on the source. The ranking weights accidents by severity and considers only streets of at least 3 km with 30 accidents; arcs without a name in OpenStreetMap are excluded.

parole: hotspot, accident concentration zone, cell, Getis-Ord, weighted severity, confidence, 250 metres.
domande: What is a hotspot?
What does confidence mean?
How is severity calculated?
testo:
With the «Accident hotspots» layer switched on, clicking a cell opens the «Accident concentration zone» profile (badge «Accident hotspot»), with:
- **Confidence (severity)** and **Confidence (count)**: confidence level as a percentage, calculated on the severity and on the count of accidents.
- **Accidents in the cell**.
- **Weighted severity**.

The note explains the method: 250 m cells, Getis-Ord Gi* statistic (Queen contiguity, 999 permutations). Severity weights fatal accidents 5, those with guarded prognosis 3, those with injuries 1, property damage only 0.2. Only the statistically significant cells appear on the map.

parole: accident, single accident, severity, fatal, injured, guarded prognosis, property damage only, year.
domande: What does the profile of an accident show?
What do the severity colours mean?
testo:
With the «Accidents» layer (from zoom 14) clicking a point opens the «Accident» profile, with the place as its title and three rows: **Year**, **Severity** and **Injured**.

Severity has four classes: **Fatal**, **Injured with guarded prognosis**, **With injuries** and **Property damage only**, each with its own colour on the map (from dark red to grey). The accidents are 2015-2023 (2019 is not in the cleaned dataset), snapped to the road network; the filter by year and severity is in the «Filters» tab.

Source: Comune di Palermo (Polizia Municipale), processed by PalermoHub / OpenDataSicilia.

parole: tooltip, hover box, mouse hover, accident safety.
domande: What do I see when I hover over a street?
testo: Hovering over a street shows the name (with the position in the ranking, for example «#5 · Via X», if it is among the 20 most dangerous) and the number of accidents with the rate per km, or «No accidents recorded». On a hotspot: «Accident concentration zone» with the accidents. On an accident: place, year, severity and injured. The hover boxes are switched on and off from the «Information overlays» menu.

titolo: What the profile of an MEF property shows
parole: MEF profile, declared property, asset, type, nature, area, volume, period of construction, cadastral identifier, use, purpose, restriction, legal status.
domande: What does the profile of a public property show?
What is the cadastral identifier?
What does «approximate position» mean?
testo:
When you click on a building, a plot of land or a point of the «Properties declared to the MEF» layer, the profile has the title «Property declared to the MEF» and, as its badge, the census year (2023). For each asset there are these rows, when the data is present:

- **Type** and **Nature** of the asset.
- **Address**.
- **Area** in m² and **Volume** in m³.
- **Period of construction**.
- **Cadastral identifier** (sheet and parcel).
- **Use** and **Purpose**.
- **Cultural or landscape restriction**.
- **Legal status**.
- **Position**: says how precise it is. «Cadastral data» (the most reliable), «Address (street number)», «Street only: approximate position» or «Municipality only: approximate position».
- **Location method**: how the polygon of the asset was found. It can be Cadastre, Municipal properties, Schools, Polling stations, Municipal offices, Monuments or Declared position. If «(MEF position corrected)» appears, the position declared to the MEF contradicted the source and was corrected.

At the bottom are the source (Ministero dell'economia e delle finanze, Dipartimento del Tesoro, census of public properties, CC BY 4.0) and the «Open data of the public real estate census» link.

titolo: Several assets in the same building
parole: several assets, list of assets, accordion, other declared assets, building with several properties.
domande: What happens if a building has several properties?
Why do I see only 12 assets?
testo: If a building contains several assets, the profile shows the list with the number of declared assets. Each entry has the type and the address as a preview; selecting it shows the details. At most 12 assets are shown: if there are more, a row «Other declared properties» says how many are missing. If there is only one asset, the rows are shown directly.

parole: tooltip, hover box, declared assets, mouse hover.
domande: What does the hover box of an MEF property show?
testo:
Hovering over a property shows «Property declared to the MEF» with the type (or nature) of the first asset, the number of declared assets and the address of the first asset.

Warning: the position of the assets is checked against the cadastre and the layers already mapped, but for some of the assets (about 2,400 out of 8,000) it is only the position declared to the MEF and cannot be verified. The data is informational.

parole: PEBA profile, details, accessibility, level, inaccessibility score, relevance, priority class, estimated cost, district average, PDF sheet.
domande: What does «Partially inaccessible» mean?
What is the inaccessibility score?
Where do I download the original sheet?
testo:
When you click on an element of the «Architectural barriers» layer, the profile has the title «PEBA – Architectural barriers» and, as its badge, the accessibility level. Below the title appear the district, neighbourhood and UPL. The groups of rows:

**Details**
- **Code** (coloured like the group), **Name**, **Address**.
- **Estimated cost** of the interventions, if given.
- **Group**, **Category**, **Urban context**, **Element**.

**Accessibility**
- **Level**: Accessible, Partially accessible, Partially inaccessible, Inaccessible or Not assessable.
- **Inaccessibility score**: from 0 to 100 (the higher it is, the more inaccessible the place), also shown with a bar.
- **Relevance** (for example High) and **Priority class** (Class 1, 2…).
- **District average**: the average score of the district, with the difference of the place from the average (for example «52 (+8)»).

titolo: Critical issues, photos and PDF sheet
parole: critical issues found, survey photos, viewer, thumbnails, original PDF, rotate photos.
domande: Where do I see the critical issues?
Can I enlarge the photos?
Where do I find the PDF?
testo:
Below the rows the profile draws the score bar, the list of the **critical issues found** (separated by semicolons in the source) and the **survey photos**. The photos are thumbnails: a click opens the **viewer**, which lets you scroll through the photos (in a loop) and rotate them. The large photos are on the PEBA site of PalermoHub.

At the bottom there are two links:
- **Open original PDF sheet**: the PDF of the survey, with the file size (some are heavy);
- **More information about the PEBA**: the presentation page of the plan on PalermoHub.

Below appears the source: Comune di Palermo, PEBA (Giunta resolution no. 272 of 18/07/2026), processed by OpenDataSicilia and PalermoHub, CC BY 4.0.

titolo: PEBA colours and groups on the map
parole: PEBA legend, groups, levels, colours, school, nursery, square, museum, historic route, UNESCO site.
domande: What types of places are in the PEBA?
How do I change the colour between level and group?
testo:
The PEBA legend works as a filter and also chooses the colour of the map: by **Accessibility** (level) or by **Group**.
- **Levels**: Accessible, Partially accessible, Partially inaccessible, Inaccessible, Not assessable.
- **Groups**: Historic route, City street, School, Nursery, Administrative/institutional office, Green area, UNESCO site (building), UNESCO route, Square, Museum.

Buildings and green areas are polygons, the rest are points with an icon for each group. Hovering shows the code, the name and a badge with the level (or the group, depending on the mode chosen).

parole: PEBA errors, geocoding, automatic extraction, inaccurate positions.
domande: Can I trust the position and the texts of the PEBA?
testo: Profiles, texts and photos were extracted automatically from the original PDFs of the survey with Python scripts and the assistance of an artificial intelligence model; the coordinates derive from the geocoding of the addresses. There may be errors, missing fields or inaccurate placements. For official data the original PDF of the Comune applies.

titolo: Where the works are in the profile
parole: Works tab, works profile, public works, right-hand profile, works without a point on the map, summary.
domande: Where do I find the details of a work?
What is in the Works tab?
How do I see the works that are not on the map?
testo:
The details of the public works are in the **Works** tab of the right-hand profile. The tab has three parts, in this order:
1. **Works without a point on the map**: a drop-down menu in two steps, «1 · Choose the owner» and «2 · Choose the work». It is for works that have no usable address (roads, scattered works, «municipal territory»…): it says how many works are on the map out of the total and lets you open the profile of any of them anyway. The badge of the title is the number of works in the menu.
2. **The profile of the work clicked** (one for each work chosen on the map).
3. **«Public works in Palermo»**: the summary with numbers and charts on all the works. The badge is the year the data was extracted.

The hover box on grouped markers invites you to click «for the list and more information»; the popup points to the profile, Works tab.

titolo: The profile of a single work
parole: owner, other owners, CUP status, phase, sector, subsector, type, nature, category, CUP, OpenCUP, description.
domande: What does «Phase (from declared dates)» mean?
What is the CUP status?
How do I see the CUP on OpenCUP?
testo:
The profile has the title of the work as its title (or the CUP, if it is missing) and the works phase as its badge. The rows, when the data exists:

**Data of the work**
- **Owner** (a click filters the map on the works of that owner) and **Other owners**.
- **CUP status**: ATTIVO (active) or CHIUSO (closed).
- **Phase (from declared dates)**: In use, Works completed, Execution finished, In execution, In design or Phase not stated. The source only says whether the CUP is active or closed: **the phase is derived from the actual dates declared by the owner**.
- **Sector**, **Subsector**, **Type**, **Nature**, **Category**.
- **Address** and **Position**: «Address (street number)» or «Street only: approximate position».
- **CUP**: the value is a link to the project page on OpenCUP.

**Declared costs and funding** (items that are zero or missing are not shown; 0 means «not stated» in the source): planned and actual works cost, planned contingency sums, planned investment charges, state, European, local authority and private funding, other sources, funding still to be found, savings.

**Dates**: actual design end; planned and actual works start and end; planned and actual completion end; actual start of use.

Below appears, if different from the title, the description of the work, then the links: «MOP Public Works projects on Open BDAP», «Open BDAP portal (location of the works)» and «Palermo public works on Cruscotto Italia». At the bottom the source: Open BDAP, Ragioneria generale dello Stato, Monitoraggio Opere Pubbliche (MOP), CC BY citing the source.

titolo: The sectors of the works and the colours
parole: sectors, social infrastructure, transport, environment, energy, education, telecommunications, research, community services, marker colour.
domande: What sectors are there?
What do the marker colours mean?
testo:
The markers of the works are ring-shaped and the colour shows the sector. The ten sectors: Social infrastructure, Transport infrastructure, Environment and water resources, Energy, Productive activities and research, Productive areas, Education and training, Telecommunications and IT, Research and innovation, Community services. The legend filters by sector, by works with a closed CUP and by owner.

Hovering over a work, the hover box shows the title (shortened), phase and CUP status, owner, planned works cost and address. A marker can group several works at the same point («N public works» or «Several addresses at the same spot»).

parole: works summary, totals, charts, works by sector, by phase, by CUP status, by year, by type, by owner, download CSV.
domande: How many works are there?
How much do they cost in total?
Can I download the list?
testo:
The summary shows three boxes: **Works** (number), **Planned works cost** and **Completed or in use** (percentage). Then it says how many works are on the map out of the total («the others have no usable address and are in the full list»). The charts:
- Works and planned cost by sector.
- Works phase (with the note that the phase is derived from the declared dates).
- CUP status.
- Works by planned completion year (with a note on the works with no date).
- By type.
- By owner (a click on an owner filters the map on its works; if some works are not on the map it says so).

At the bottom there is the link to download the full list (CSV) with the extraction date.

titolo: Where the PNRR projects are in the profile
parole: NRRP tab, PNRR tab, PNRR profile, PNRR projects, implementing body, projects without a place, summary, drop-down menu, Municipality and University.
domande: Where do I find the details of a PNRR project?
How do I see the projects that are not on the map?
What is in the NRRP tab?
testo:
The details of the PNRR projects are in the **NRRP** tab of the right-hand profile. The tab has three parts, in this order:
1. **«All Municipality and University projects»**: two drop-down menus, «1 · Choose the body» and «2 · Choose the project». These bodies have many projects, some with no point on the map: you choose the body and then the project to see its profile. The badge is the number of projects in the menu.
2. **The profile of the project clicked** (one for each project chosen on the map).
3. **«NRRP in Palermo»**: the summary with numbers and charts on all the projects. The badge is the year the data was extracted.

On the map there are only the projects that have a place; the others (training, research, scholarships, networks…) can be consulted in the NRRP tab and in the full list in CSV. The hover box on grouped markers invites you to click «for the list and more information»; the popup points to the profile, NRRP tab. A marker can group several projects at the same point («N NRRP projects» or «Several addresses at the same spot»).

titolo: The profile of a single PNRR project
parole: mission, component, measure, status, implementing body, PNRR funding, total cost, planned start, actual end, CUP, OpenCUP.
domande: What does «M2» mean?
What is the PNRR funding?
Who is carrying out the project?
How do I see the CUP?
testo:
The profile has the project title as its title and, as its badge, «PNRR» with the mission (for example «PNRR M2»). The rows, when the data exists:
- **Mission** with its name, **Component**, **Measure**.
- **Status**: Completed or In progress, as declared in the source.
- **Implementing body**: a click filters the map on the projects of that body.

Below appears the project description, then the links «Italia Domani open data catalogue», «Project locations (CSV)» and «Palermo NRRP on Cruscotto Italia». At the bottom the source: Italia Domani, Struttura di missione PNRR (NRRP Mission Unit), Sogei, open data catalogue (CC BY 4.0).

parole: missions, M1, M2, M3, M4, M5, M6, M7, REPowerEU, mission colours.
domande: What are the missions M1-M7?
testo:
In the app there are seven missions, each with a colour (the slices of the ring of the markers):
- **M1** Digitalisation, innovation, competitiveness, culture and tourism.
- **M2** Green revolution and ecological transition.
- **M3** Infrastructure for sustainable mobility.
- **M4** Education and research.
- **M5** Inclusion and cohesion.

domande: How many PNRR projects are there?
How many are completed?
Can I download the list?
testo:
The summary shows three boxes: **Projects** (number), **NRRP funding** and **Completed** (percentage). Then it says how many projects are on the map out of the total («the others have no address and are in the full list»). The charts:
- Funding by mission.
- Progress status.
- Projects by planned end year (with a note on the projects with no date).
- Sectors.
- Implementing bodies (a click on a body filters the map on its projects).

At the bottom there are the «Download the full list (CSV)» link and the note: projects located only in the city of Palermo; status, amounts and dates are those declared in the source (with the extraction date) and **have not been checked on the ground**.

titolo: What the profile of a monumental tree shows
parole: tree profile, monumental tree, homogeneous group, species, locality, trunk circumference, height, altitude, monumentality criteria, MASAF record.
domande: What does the profile of a tree show?
What does «homogeneous group» mean?
What are the monumentality criteria?
testo:
When you click on a point of the «Monumental trees (MASAF)» layer, the profile has the name of the tree (or the species) as its title and, as its badge, **«Monumental tree»** or **«Homogeneous group»** (a group of trees indicated as a single element). The rows, when the data exists:
- **Species** and **Locality**.
- **Trunk circumference** in cm and **Height** in m. For homogeneous groups the labels become «Trunk circumference (max)» and «Height (max)».
- **Altitude** in m a.s.l.
- **Monumentality criteria**: the list of criteria given in the ministerial record.
- **Proposal for declaration of significant public interest**: «yes» or «no».
- **MASAF record**: the reference to the record in the ministerial list.

At the bottom there are the «MASAF list of monumental trees» link and the source: MASAF, list of the monumental trees of Italy (MASAF is the Ministry of Agriculture, Food Sovereignty and Forests). Clicking on a tree on the map also shows a popup with the same rows.

titolo: What the profile of a drinking fountain shows
parole: drinking fountain profile, drinking water, address, location, name, notes, neighbourhood, district, AMAP, water fountain.
domande: What does the profile of a drinking fountain show?
Who does the data come from?
Where do I find the map of the drinking fountains?
testo:
When you click on a point of the «Public drinking fountains» layer, the profile has the title **«Drinking fountain»** and the badge **«Drinking water»**. The rows, when the data exists:
- **Address**.
- **Location** (the type of location).
- **Name**.
- **Notes**.

The popup on the map adds **Neighbourhood** and **District** and, as a subtitle, the UPL (or the neighbourhood).

At the bottom there is the «For more details see the drinking fountains map» link, which leads to the map of the drinking fountains and of walking coverage on PalermoHub. Source: AMAP S.p.A., public drinking fountains of Palermo. In the place profile the section is in the services group (same weight as the charging points).

titolo: What the Heat island profile shows
parole: heat island profile, summer temperature, compared with the city average, change, Landsat, trend chart, census section, urban heat island, hot spot.
domande: What does «Compared with the city average» mean?
Since when is the change calculated?
Is it the air temperature?
testo:
When you click on a section of the «Heat islands» layer (or on a point that falls in a section with data), the profile has the title **«Heat island»** and, as its badge, the summer temperature in °C. It is in the «Terrain» tab of the place profile. The rows:
- **Summer temperature**: value in °C with the year in brackets (the latest year available, 2025).
- **Compared with the city average**: the difference in °C between the section and the average of the Comune, with the sign (+ hotter, − cooler).
- **Change since 2019**: the difference in °C between the temperature of the latest year and that of the first year of the series (2019), if available.

Below the rows the profile draws a trend chart. At the bottom there is the «Full study on heat islands» link (PalermoHub: maps by year, bivariate and «true island» purged of the effect of the territory).

The source is written in the profile: Landsat 8/9 (USGS), summer land surface temperature, processed by ISTAT census section. **It is not the air temperature.**

titolo: What the charging points profile shows
parole: charging points profile, charging points, EV charging, operator, power kW, current, connector, opening hours, status, available, real time, list.
domande: How do I see the nearby charging points?
What does «Not updated in real time» mean?
What does «Always open» mean?
testo:
In the place profile, the charging points near the clicked point are gathered in a single entry, **«Charging points»**, which has the number of charging points as its badge. The summary says how many there are and how many are «available». Above the list there are the charts for all the charging points of the Comune.

The list is an accordion: «Select a charging point to see the details». Each entry has the address (or the operator) as its title and the status as a preview. When opened, it shows the rows, when the data exists:
- **Operator**, **Address**.
- **Power** in kW with the type of current in brackets.
- **Connector** and the number of **Connectors**.
- **Opening hours**: «Always open (24 hours a day)» for the 24-hour charging points.
- **Status**: if the charging point is not updated in real time by the operator, the profile says «Not updated in real time by the operator».

The popup on the map shows operator, status, address, power, connector and number of connectors.

At the bottom there is the «Charging points in Sicily» link (EVChargingLogSicilia of PalermoHub: usage, trends and forecasts). The source also gives the date of the last status update: GSE, Piattaforma Unica Nazionale (PUN), through PalermoHub/evcharginglogsicilia, CC BY 4.0.

titolo: What the OMI price quotations profile shows
parole: OMI profile, OMI quotations, OMI zone, band, micro-zone, sale, rent, €/m², gross area, net area, type, property prices, price per square metre.
domande: How do I read the quotations of a zone?
What does the «Semi-central» band mean?
What are gross area and net area?
testo:
When you click on a point that falls inside a zone of the «OMI zones 2025» layer, the profile is titled **«OMI price quotations»** and has as its badge **«Zone»** with the code of the zone. The rows:
- **Zone**: the code, with the colour of the zone in the legend.
- **Band**: the letter and the description. The bands are: B Central, C Semi-central, D Peripheral, E Suburban, R Rural.
- **Description** of the zone and **Micro-zone**, if present.

Below there is the accordion list «Select a type to see sale and rent». The summary gives the prevailing type (with its code in square brackets). Each type shows as a preview the sale range and, when opened:
- **Sale**: minimum – maximum range in €/m².
- **Rent**: minimum – maximum range in €/m² per month.

Next to the ranges «sup.lorda» (gross area) or «sup.netta» (net area) appears, which says whether the quotation refers to the gross or the net area. Where the figure is missing there is «—».

At the bottom there is the link «Cadastre and zoning plan on map» (PalermoHub) and the source with the half-year (for example «OMI 2025 S2»). The quotations are indicative ranges from the Osservatorio del Mercato Immobiliare of the Agenzia delle Entrate, not the sale prices of a property.

titolo: What the PAI constraints profile shows
parole: PAI profile, PAI constraints, hazard class, risk class, overlapping constraints, most severe, element at risk, measures, River Basin Authority, hydrogeological plan, flood hazard.
domande: What does «most severe» mean?
What are the measures?
Why are there several constraints at the same point?
testo:
When you click on an area of a layer in the «PAI plan» group, the profile shows the constraint. The title is that of the theme (for example hydraulic hazard) and the badge is the class (the letter or number of the class, if the theme has one). The rows depend on the theme and are only there when the data exists: the classes of the theme, the description of the element, the **Area** in hectares and the **Length** in metres. A group **«Measures»** gathers, when there are any, the numbers and dates of the measures linked to the constraint.

If several constraints overlap at the same point, the profile gathers them in one entry **«PAI constraints»** with the number of constraints and a summary of the type «N overlapping constraints · most severe: [class] ([theme])». Each constraint opens by selecting it: «Select a constraint to see the details». The most severe class is chosen by comparing the number of the class.

Hovering or opening the popup shows the theme, the class, the place, the element at risk, the area and the length.

The same most severe class also appears in the «PAI constraints» box of the «Planning tools» section of the place profile.

Source written in the profile: Regione Siciliana, Autorità di Bacino, Piano di Assetto Idrogeologico (PAI), SITR; constraints in the Municipality of Palermo. The data is for information: for legal uses the official cartography of the Autorità di Bacino prevails.

titolo: What the profile of a fire shows
parole: fire profile, wildfire, date, locality, starting place, type of event, total area, wooded, non-wooded, land use, intervention, duration, AIB crews, firefighting cost, injured, deaths.
domande: What does the profile of a fire show?
How long did the intervention last?
What are the AIB crews?
testo:
When you click on an area of the «Fires» layer, the profile is titled «Fire at [locality]» (or «Fire [year]» if the locality is missing) and has as its badge «Fire [year]». The groups, with only the rows that have a value:

**General data**
- **Date** (day/month/year), **Locality**, **Starting place**, **Type of event**.

**Areas**
- **Total area**, **Wooded area**, **Non-wooded area**, **Other forest areas**, all in hectares (ha).
- **Land use** and **Scorch height**.

**Intervention**
- **End of intervention** and **Duration of intervention** (in hours and minutes).
- **AIB crews**.
- **Firefighting cost** in euro.
- **Injured** and **Deaths**.

If several fires overlap at the same point, the profile gathers them in one entry **«Fires»** with the number and a summary («N overlapping fires · from [year] to [year]»); each fire opens by selecting it. The popup on the map shows title, date and the three areas (total, wooded, non-wooded).

Source written in the profile: Regione Siciliana, Corpo Forestale, Censimento Incendi (SIF), perimeters of the areas burnt by fire in the Municipality of Palermo.

titolo: What the fuel stations profile shows
parole: fuel stations profile, petrol, diesel, LPG, methane, self-service, serviced, prices of, other fuels, operator, brand, nearby fuel stations, fuel prices, petrol stations.
domande: How do I see the prices of nearby fuel stations?
What do «self» and «serviced» mean?
What date are the prices from?
testo:
In the place profile, the fuel stations near the clicked point are gathered in one entry **«Fuel stations»** with the number as its badge. The list is an accordion: «Select a station to see the prices». Each entry has as its title the brand (or the operator) and as a preview the distance from the point. When opened, it shows:
- **Operator** and **Address**.
- **Petrol**, **Diesel**, **LPG**, **Methane (CNG)**: for each one the self-service and/or serviced price, with three decimals.

titolo: Profile of a school or nursery
parole: school profile, nursery, school building, institute, site, polling station, sections, school.
domande: What does the profile of a school show?
What does «Polling station» mean inside the profile of a school?

parole: polling station profile, polling place, electoral sections, district, voting.
domande: Which sections vote at this polling station?
testo:
When you click on a point of the «Polling sections (sites)» layer, the profile has the name of the site as its title, the voting icon and the type as its badge. The group **«Polling station»** gives the number of sections and the list of the sections hosted. The popup on the map adds **Address** and **District**.

The polling stations that coincide with a school are shown in the profile of the school («Polling station» group). The data is the open data of the Municipality of Palermo from 2017.

titolo: What the profile of an office site shows
parole: offices profile, site, area, sector, operational unit, U.O., manager, contacts, telephone numbers, email, offices and managers, municipal offices.
domande: What is in the profile of a municipal site?
How do I find the manager of an office?
What is a U.O.?
testo:
When you click on a site of the «Municipal offices (sites)» layer, the profile has the name of the site as its title and «Municipal offices» as its badge. The rows:
- **Address**.
- **Offices**: how many offices are based there.
- **Areas**: in how many areas of the Municipality they are organised.

Below there is the accordion list **«Offices and managers (N)»**: one entry for each area, with the number of offices. titolo: Profile of a stop or a station
parole: stop profile, station, metro, bus stop, tram, lines that serve it, wheelchair accessible, opening soon, next departures.
domande: What does the profile of a stop show?
What does «Opening soon» mean?
How do I see whether it is wheelchair accessible?
testo:
When you click on a stop, the profile has the name as its title and as its badge **«Stop»** (bus and tram) or **«Station»** (metro and railway), with the icon of the bus or of the train. The rows, when the data exists:
- **Status**: «Opening soon» for the stations not yet open.
- **Lines**: the list of the lines that serve it.
- **Wheelchair accessible**.

Below the rows the profile has a dynamic part with the lines that serve the stop and the next departures (see the guide «Stops of bus, tram and metro lines»). Hovering over a stop, the tooltip shows the name and the list of the lines; for stations that are opening soon it says so.

parole: lines profile, line, directions, tram, bus, metro, line number, line colour.
domande: How do I see a line?
What is in the «Lines» box?
testo:
When you click on the route of a line (or on a stop), the profile shows an entry **«Line [number]»** if there is only one line, or **«N lines»** if there are more than one. The badge gives the type: Tram, Metro or Bus. Each line has its directions and its colour. Hovering over the route, the tooltip shows the first four lines (number, name and colour) and «others» if there are more.

parole: trend profile, change 2011-2021, UPL, neighbourhood, district, chart, projection 2030, 2035, band, trend, population change, population growth, population decline.
domande: What does the trend profile show?
What does the «Trend +5%» badge mean?
What are the 2030 and 2035 points?
testo:
In the **«Population»** tab of the place profile the entry **«Population trend 2011-2023»** appears. It shows the three levels of the clicked point: the **UPL**, the **Neighbourhood** and the **District**. The badge is «Trend» followed by the percentage change 2011-2021 of the UPL.

- The group **«Change 2011-2021»** lists, for each level and with its name, the percentage change in inhabitants between 2011 and 2021.
- Below, a chart for each level: the observed points 2011, 2021 and 2023 and the points of the **trend scenario** 2030 and 2035, with an uncertainty band. The years are abbreviated (’11, ’21, ’23, ’30, ’35).

The colours follow the change: purple when the population falls, green when it grows. Hovering over an area shows the name and an «Inhabitants 2011-2021» badge with the change.

The profile gives the source (ISTAT, Census 2011, Permanent Census 2021 and 2023; processing by DigitalTwin Palermo, with the 2011 population distributed over the current areas by overlay) and a note of caution: **the 2011 census (traditional) and those of 2021 and 2023 (permanent, sample-based) are not fully comparable**, and the changes of a single area between 2021 and 2023 should be read with caution.

parole: commuting profile, inbound, outbound, balance, live and work in Palermo, ranking of municipalities, commuters 2021, remote working, commuters, work travel.
domande: What does «Balance» mean?
What are inbound and outbound?
Why is the 2021 data special?
testo:
In the **«Population»** tab of the place profile the entry **«Commuting for work»** appears, with the badge **2021**. If you clicked on a municipality, there is a group with the name of the municipality and three rows:
- **Inbound (work in Palermo)**: people who live in that municipality and work in Palermo.
- **Outbound (Palermo residents)**: residents of Palermo who work in that municipality.
- **Balance (inbound − outbound)**, with the sign + or −.

Below, the profile draws a summary and rankings: how many live and work in Palermo, how many leave, how many come in, the balance and the shares; the ranking of the linked municipalities (the top 25 links, if they weigh at least 1% of the total of the direction) and the municipalities with the largest balance.

On the map, hovering over Palermo shows «Live and work here» with the number; over a municipality it shows the **Balance**, in blue if positive (more people come in) and orange if negative.

Source and cautions written in the profile: ISTAT, Permanent Census 2021, commuting-for-work matrix (CC BY 4.0), original map by PalermoHub. **Data at 31 December 2021, in the middle of the pandemic: the movements may reflect remote working. The municipalities are represented by their centroid and the arc is not the real route.** There is a link to the original «Commuting» map.

parole: address profile, street, house number, street number, suffix, nearest house number, Place tab, how to find an address.
domande: How do I find out the address of a point?
What does a house number with a slash, like 12/A, mean?
testo:
When you click on the map, in the **«Place»** tab the section **«Address»** appears, with two rows:
- **Street**: the name of the road (odonym).
- **Number**: the house number; if it has a suffix it is written with a slash, for example «12/A».

parole: building profile, height, use, residents estimate, UNK, volumetric unit, building data.
domande: What does the profile of a building show?
What does «Use: UNK» mean?
How is the number of residents calculated?
testo:
When you click on a building, the section **«Building»** appears in the **«Place»** tab and, copied, also at the start of the **«Planning tools»** tab. The rows, when the data exists:
- **Height** in metres (one decimal).
- **Use**: the intended use present in the data. If the value is «UNK» (not known) it is considered weak: when in the same building there is a monument, a school or a polling station, the profile shows **«Monument»**, **«School or nursery»** or **«Polling station»** instead.
- **Residents (estimate)**: estimated number of residents, rounded.

The figure is an **estimate**: the population per building is not a count. The polygons of the buildings are the volumetric units of the Carta Tecnica Comunale (Municipality of Palermo).

parole: parcel profile, cadastral parcel, sheet, parcel number, extract, SISTER, SPID, Agenzia delle Entrate, cadastral extract, land registry.
domande: How do I find the sheet and parcel of a point?
How do I get the extract?
Can I get the extract from here?
testo:
When you click on the map, in the **«Planning tools»** tab the section **«Cadastral parcel»** appears, with two rows:
- **Sheet**.
- **Parcel**.

Below there are two links:
- **«Extract on SISTER»**, with the label «Fg.[sheet] · P.[parcel]». It opens SISTER (portal of the Agenzia delle Entrate). - **«Cadastre, zoning plan and constraints on map»**: the PalermoHub map.
